name: Tuvalu

fees.name: Visitor Permit (issued on arrival)
fees.applies: most nationalities requiring a visa (Schengen and Taiwanese nationals visa-exempt for up to 90 days per some sources)
fees.notes: US Department of State travel advisory (official government source, not Tuvalu's own portal) states visitor permits are issued on arrival for a fee of AUD 100, valid up to one month. Tuvalu's own official immigration site (gov.tv, Immigration & Customs page) could not be reached during this research (DNS resolution failure) to independently confirm; this fee is corroborated by multiple secondary sources (ivisa, visaHQ) citing the same AUD 100 amount.

free_visa_notes: No separate embassy-issued tourist e-visa, eTA, or business visa fee schedule was found; Tuvalu appears to operate primarily an on-arrival visitor permit system (AUD 100) rather than a pre-arrival visa regime. Could not independently verify against Tuvalu's own official immigration portal (gov.tv) due to a DNS/connectivity failure during this research session; amount is corroborated by the US State Department and multiple secondary visa-information sites but should be re-verified against gov.tv when reachable.
